integrity: The theorem uses exact finite-state path equivalence and a fully reproducible 256-rule closure with direct finite-word crosschecks. Scientific self-review is not independent certification.
limitations: The conclusion is only for binary nearest-neighbor rules on the bilateral full shift and compares exactly the first two image sets. Eventual stabilization for initially shrinking images and generalizations to larger radii are not established. Historical priority requires external validation.
title: A sharp twelve-symbol threshold for second-update image loss in elementary cellular automata
